exposure: invasive care such as extra-corporeal circulation
finding: The prevalence of neonatal arterial ischemic stroke (NAIS) in term or near term newborns varies from 6 to 17/100,000 live births and risk factors include male sex, obstetric determinants (first pregnancy, caesarean section), and two peripartum complications: intrapartum hypoxia and materno-fetal/neonatal infection.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was identified as a risk factor for neonatal arterial ischemic stroke.
